description: Texmo Pipes and Products Limited manufactures and trades in plastic pipes and fittings in India. The company provides CPVC, UPVC, and SWR pipes and fittings; garden hose pipes; CM, CS, RS and blue casing pipe; HDPE pipes and coils; colum pipes; DRIP rolls; sprinkler pipes and accessories; and PTMT fittings; mini sprinkler rolls and spray pipe, etc. It also offers water tanks; rigid PVC pipes and agriculture fittings; suction hose; casing pipes; sanitary products; and solvent cement under the TEXMO brand. The company was formerly known as Shree Mohit Industries and changed its name to Texmo Pipes and Products Limited in July 2008. Texmo Pipes and Products Limited was founded in 1999 and is based in Burhanpur, India.
